rows.grounds: first member of compound with udakena

items.question: How should the performer be consecrated with water after completing the prescribed mantra recitation?
premises: The performer is to be sprinkled with water from a pot.
The sprinkling is to be done while remembering the mantra.
This act constitutes a ritual application following mantra recitation.
items.inference: Consecration of the performer is accomplished by sprinkling pot-water while mentally holding the mantra.
uncertainties: Whether karttāram refers to the officiant himself or another participant.
items.plain_english: One should sprinkle the performer with water from a pot while remembering the mantra.
